notes: ruling needed (rule 11): «شهدت عمرو بن أبي حسن سأل عبد الله بن زيد عن وضوء النبي» is a narrated encounter in which Abdullah b. Zayd speaks and acts; the father's witness is the last link written; whether Abdullah is a link too is not settled
«عمرو بن أبي حسن» asks inside the father's story: in the scene, not a link (rule 5)
the second isnad «وحدثنا موسى قال حدثنا وهيب قال مسح رأسه مرة» carries a different saying (wiping the head once); it is not a route for this saying and is held out (rules 4, 11)
«أبيه» is bare: a relation link (rule 7); the names other sources give for it are not written
